comments.author: @sureshpatel-pk9jn

comments.text:
Thank You so much for taking interest in our channel,  Great question! Section 45 does have specific provisions regarding policy claims after three years. Generally, it means that after the initial three years, insurers cannot contest the validity of a policy based on misrepresentation. However, it's always best to read the policy details carefully or consult with a financial advisor for specific cases. Thanks for bringing this up
